title: Ceiling fan not working in Room 304
description: The ceiling fan in Room 304 does not turn on even though the switch works. The room gets very hot during afternoon classes.

title: Broken chairs in the reading room
description: Three chairs near the window in the main reading room have broken legs and are unsafe to sit on.

title: Projector shows no signal
description: The projector in Lab 2 shows 'No Signal' with every laptop and HDMI cable we tried. Lab classes are affected.

title: No water in 2nd floor washroom
description: The taps in the 2nd floor male washroom have had no water supply since yesterday morning.

title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting in cafeteria
description: The campus Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes in the cafeteria seating area, making it hard to study between classes.
